_INSTRUCTIONS: Fill each [] with rows from YOUR licensed manual, then rename this file (e.g. norms.vineland2.local.json) and import it via the app's 'Nạp bảng chuẩn (.json)' button on the Results tab. Numbers here are 0/empty placeholders. Ranges are INCLUSIVE. Keep the _comment keys or delete them — the app ignores unknown keys. Add more objects to ageBands for more age bands. Set verified to true only after you have checked every value against the manual.
source: Typed from licensed Vineland-II manual by <name>, <date>

ageBands._comment_band: One age band. minMonths/maxMonths inclusive, in months. Example: ages 4:0-4:11 => 48 to 59.
ageBands._comment_b1: Table B.1. For each subdomain, list {min,max,value}: min-max = raw-score range, value = v-scale (1-24).

_comment_b2: Table B.2 (+ C.3 percentile). Per domain: {sumVMin,sumVMax,standard,percentile}. sumV = sum of that domain's subdomain v-scales. Optional ci95:[low,high].
_comment_ageeq: Optional. Per subdomain: {min,max,value} where value = age-equivalent in MONTHS (1:9 => 21).
_comment_composite: Optional. ABC: {sumVMin,sumVMax,standard,percentile}. sumV = sum of the 4 (or 3 for age 7+) domain standard scores.
